title: Phase 2: SSH socket-forward transport (no remote docker-on-PATH needed)
description: Forward remote /var/run/docker.sock over ssh (-L localsock:remotesock), point API client + compose at unix://localsock. No remote docker binary/PATH needed (fixes Synology/restrictive hosts). Persistent supervised ssh tunnel per host (execpg, reconnect+backoff, readiness wait, teardown on invalidate/shutdown). Migration 006: hosts.transport ('forward' default | 'dial-stdio') + hosts.remote_socket (default /var/run/docker.sock). API+UI: transport selector + socket path. Depends on Phase 1 (stackd-025).
close_reason: Phase 2 done: socket-forward + dial-stdio local-socket proxy + configurable dockerPath. Real-host test on madara: forward blocked by Synology sshd, dial-stdio works. Gates green; all codex findings fixed. Epic stays open for future phases.

title: Phase 1 backend: hosts table, ssh docker dialer, apply/state routing, hosts API

Resolve stack->host (override->repo->local). Apply: set DOCKER_HOST + managed HOME/.ssh for compose CLI per host. Route state/logs/exec to per-host client. API /api/settings/hosts CRUD + test-connection; repo host_id; stack host override endpoint; validate docker_host (empty or ssh://, reject others). Tests: host resolution, docker_host validation, dialer arg construction, ssh config generation.

title: EPIC: multi-host support (one stackd manages many Docker hosts)
